version.changelog: Refreshed content + GitHub star link in footer

llm.summary: This is a content-only strategy analysis skill with no code, credential access, or hidden execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently provide an S-curve technology adoption framework, examples, and sources for market-growth diagnosis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to coaching, asking the user for adoption data, applying the framework, and stopping for user responses at marked points.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown files; no executable scripts, install hooks, package managers, or clawpack URL are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, network, credential, local profile, account, or mutation authority; external links are limited to references and publisher promotion.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, memory writes, or autonomous agent spawning instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installing this skill should mainly affect how the agent reasons about technology adoption and market saturation. Review the publisher’s external links if you care about provenance, but the artifact itself does not ask for sensitive access or perform actions.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean scan] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, matching the inspected content-only Markdown artifacts.
[Static scan clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and manual review found no executable or hidden high-impact behavior.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
